ceo.title: Connecting People to Opportunities, Building a Successful Future
paragraphs: As CEO and Founder, I am proud to lead a company with a clear mission: to help Cambodian workers access safe, legal and meaningful employment, and to grow their careers in the international labour market.

We believe a job is more than a source of income. It is a chance for personal growth, new skills and a better future for families and communities. That is why we prepare every worker with training, guidance and support before they travel.
To our employers and partners: we are committed to long-term partnerships built on reliable, disciplined and well-prepared Cambodian workers. Thank you for your trust and continued support.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers for workers planning to go to Malaysia.

items.q: What jobs are available in Malaysia?
items.a: There are five types of work: factory work, construction, rubber plantation agriculture, team cleaning services, and housemaid work (not officially open yet, please wait).

items.q: How long after registering until I can leave?
items.a: There are two stages. After registration, the wait is usually 3 to 6 months. After you pass the interview, departure is usually within 1 to 1.5 months.

items.q: What documents do I need to register?
items.a: Five documents: a copy of your birth certificate, family book or residence book, national ID card, health certificate, and passport.

items.q: Can I register if I don't have money?
items.a: Yes. The company provides a 100% loan through our partner bank to cover all document costs.

items.q: How much salary will I earn in Malaysia?
items.a: The base salary is RM 1,800 (Malaysian Ringgit) per month, plus overtime where available.
Applicants aged 18 to 45 years old are accepted.

hero.title: Bridging Borders, Fulfilling Dreams
hero.subtitle: AA Labour Cambodia Supply Co., Ltd. is a legally licensed recruitment and manpower supply company in the Kingdom of Cambodia (License No. 121/19).

intro: We specialise in the recruitment, training and overseas placement of skilled, semi-skilled and general workers, serving as a trusted bridge between qualified Cambodian workers, reputable employers and international business partners.

With a strong commitment to professionalism, integrity, transparency and compliance with labour standards, we deliver reliable workforce solutions while creating better opportunities for Cambodian workers to raise their income, develop their skills and improve their quality of life.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.text: To become one of Cambodia's leading and most trusted recruitment companies, recognised internationally for high-quality workforce solutions and for ethical, professional and responsible overseas employment.

purpose.title: Our purpose
purpose.text: To create legitimate employment opportunities for Cambodian workers while providing high-quality workforce solutions to employers around the world.

mission.title: Our mission
items: Provide international employers with skilled, disciplined and well-prepared Cambodian workers.
Help Cambodian workers access legal, safe and rewarding overseas jobs that improve their income and quality of life.
Maintain high professional standards based on transparency, accountability, integrity and ethical conduct.
Build long-term partnerships with employers and agencies worldwide, founded on trust and shared success.
Contribute to Cambodia's economic and social development by connecting workers with international labour markets.
